exposure: total area under the curve of the diagnostic 75-g oral glucose tolerance test
weight gain before diagnosis of GDM
cohort: 2647 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Increased insulin resistance in the late second trimester was significantly associated with preterm delivery in women with GDM.
